title: docs(pm-dispatch): name the two review steps L1 普通审核 and L2 契约审核
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbQSZzPCABTw4GkNDmHqBhBk)_

Fixes #34021

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:pm-dispatch 规则把两步审核定名为 L1 普通审核与 L2 契约审核;入口多一段 5 行术语表;「复核席」改叫 L2 席(`l2-review#N`),两份文件更名并在旧路径留一行指针;脚本同时认新旧两种写法。
- 为什么改:「复核 / 复审」一词两用,只管 L2 席的账号与独立性规则被套到了普通审核线程上;你在 2026-11-15 定了名(裁决记录:本卡评论 6897685514)。
- 风险与回滚:在座的 `review#N` 席、它的信箱分支、签名和已有记录全部照读,不需要迁移;本 PR 含 1 行 `AGENTS.md`(Tier S 的中文名),因此整体按 Tier H 落地,单独回退提交 e191011e 即回到 Tier S;整体回滚 = revert 本 PR。
- 先看:① `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md` 的〈审核两级〉5 行;② `references/lanes/l2-review.md` 第 7 行(别名)与第 20 行(独立性);③ `scripts/pm/mailbox-open.mjs` 的 `SEAT_BARE_LANES` 一行。
- 两分钟验证:运行 `node scripts/pm/mailbox-open.mjs --self-test`,预期末行 `92 cases in 10 batteries pass`,其中一例同时读出 `l2-review#1` 与 `review#1`。
- 需要你做的:批准本 PR(因含 1 行 `AGENTS.md`)。

## What changes

**Rules text** (`.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/**`, `.claude/agents/os-dev.md`, one line of `AGENTS.md`)

- `SKILL.md` gains a 〈审核两级〉 section between 〈优先级〉 and 〈入口与角色〉, 5 bullets: what L1 is and who owes it; what L2 is and that it never replaces L1; which L2 faces need `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` and which run at `TIER_DEFAULT`; L1 rules do not reach L2 and L2 rules do not reach L1, and the L2 seat's account, independence, mailbox and record-only rules bind the L2 seat alone; GitHub PR review and CI check names belong to neither, and the old words and old paths are read, not written.
- Every bare 复核 / 复审 / 审核 that meant one of the two steps now says L1 or L2 (145 lines; the per-line census is under Acceptance notes). Where one word covered both steps the line says `L1/L2`.
- Renamed, each with a one-line stub at the old path: `references/lanes/review.md` to `references/lanes/l2-review.md`, `references/review-checklist.md` to `references/l1-review-checklist.md`.
- The L2 seat is `l2-review#N`; the charter carries one alias line saying `review#N`, the seat word `review` and 「复核」 stay read, seated seats keep their name, new seats and new writes use `l2-review`.
- Thread naming (`references/area-lease.md` line 13): new L1 threads are `L1-a`, `L1-b` and so on; running threads keep their names; the L2 charter's seat rules do not reach them.
- Two lines lose an account clause, which is a change of substance and not only of wording. `references/area-lease.md` line 13 on main said the area's review seat is sat by another account and a same-account sitting needs the maintainer's own word in that thread; it now says only that there is one L1 thread per 3 active areas, how new ones are named, and that the L2 charter's seat rules do not reach them. `references/lanes/l2-review.md` line 20 replaces the phrase that named `area-lease.md` as the exception with (L1 线程不限). Reason: the card's first acceptance item rules that the review lane's account and independence rules belong to L2 only, and those area threads are L1; restoring the clause is a one-line edit on line 13 if that reading is wrong.
- `references/dispatch-runbook.md` line 219 keeps its timing: 应派发前送 L1 线程 (an L1 review finding on the first head, where the rename had dropped 派发前; the line's tail loses one particle to stay under the 120-byte cap).
- `AGENTS.md` line 291: the Tier S parenthesis reads 席内达档 L2 审核落地. This is the only AGENTS.md line the census hit, and it is its own commit (e191011e).

**Scripts** (`scripts/pm/**`, plus `scripts/check-required-contexts.mjs`)

- `mailbox-open.mjs`: `SEAT_BARE_LANES` gains `l2-review` beside `review`; new exports `L2_REVIEW_LANE`, `L2_REVIEW_LANE_WORDS`, `isL2ReviewLane`. The two words are separate seat keys on purpose, so `mailbox/LOGIN/review-1` and every signature already on the board keep reading.
- `check-half-states.mjs`: the seat signature's lane alternation gains `l2-review`.
- `fleet-roster.mjs`: the L2 row, its claim reading and the seat-title parse read both words (the title token used to stop at the digit, reading `l2-review` as lane `l`).
- `check-owed-reviews.mjs`: both words are L2 seats, each named by the word its own seat post spells; the printed rows and the help text say "L2 seat".
- `record-recognisers.mjs`: the hand-off target accepts `l2-review#N` and `review#N`; a claim signed under either word is the review side; the hand-off template and the mailbox-key registry text name the new word.
- `post-stamped.mjs`: the refusal for a contract-review knock addressed to triage points at `To: l2-review#N`.
- `check-governed-merges.mjs`, `check-governed-queue-guard.mjs`: the Tier S name they print follows the AGENTS.md line.
- `check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs`: rows re-keyed for the two renames, two stub rows of 1, and the two raises below.
- `scripts/check-required-contexts.mjs` (outside `scripts/pm/`, declared): the instruction-surface entry that requires the checklist to name the two required check-runs now points at `l1-review-checklist.md`, where that content lives; left on the old path the scan would read the stub.
- Pointers to the renamed files and headings follow in `ensure-pm-labels.sh`, `dispatch-gates.self-test.mjs`, `dispatch-gates.data.mjs`.

**Not renamed, and why**

- `contract-review.md`, `Contract-review-claim:`, `Contract-review-handoff:`, `Contract-review-hold:`, `needs:contract-review`, `Request: contract-review`, `Notify: contract-review`, `## Contract review`, `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`: each already says "contract", so none of them says only "review" (the dispatch order's assumption A2, confirmed by the census).
- `Reviewed-by:` / `Implemented-by:`: they exist only inside a `## Contract review` record, six readers including the required queue guard read them, and no L1 artefact carries them. Kept; raised as an open question in the report.
- The JSON values and internal names of the tools (`side: 'review'`, `reviewSeat`, `reviewClaims`): machine-read, no person writes them.

|---|---|---|---|---|
| `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md` | 320 | 328 | 328 | +8: the glossary (heading, blank, 5 bullets, blank). Row raised citing ruling record 6897685514, quoted in the ratchet row |
| `references/lanes/l2-review.md` (was `lanes/review.md`) | 21 | 22 | 22 | +1: the alias line. Row re-keyed and raised citing the same record |
| `references/l1-review-checklist.md` (was `review-checklist.md`) | 76 | 76 | 76 | row re-keyed, no raise |
| `references/lanes/review.md` (stub) | 21 | 1 | 1 | new row |
| `references/review-checklist.md` (stub) | 76 | 1 | 1 | new row |
| every other edited rules file (26) and `AGENTS.md` | same | same | same | every edit is line-for-line; the 120-byte line cap holds |

Ruling quoted for both raises (maintainer, 2026-11-15, verbatim): 「复审车道和你这里的复审不是一个概念吗？ 你派出的任务需要审核，但未必都需要契约复审」 · 「我觉得一步到位，先和我讨论区别最明显的名字，座位也可以改」 · 「L1 普通审核 / L2 契约审核」. Measured delta: SKILL.md +8, references +1 excluding the two stubs.

## Tests

Head 661e467b (after the merge of `origin/main` e71ecc1b; main's own changes moved three counts: mailbox-open lost its lock battery, record-recognisers one case, check-governed-merges gained assertions). The edited scripts have no `*.test.ts` suite; their suite is their own `--self-test`, run through the `check:pm-*` families below.

<details>

```
✓ mailbox-open self-test: 92 cases in 10 batteries pass.
✓ fleet-roster self-test: 116 cases in 9 batteries pass.

✓ record-recognisers self-test: 401 cases pass
```

</details>

New cases, each reading the old AND the new spelling: the opener (`l2-review#1` key, slug, mailbox body, `domain:l2-review` refused, plus the unchanged `review#1` case); the roster (title `l2-review · seat 2`, a claim signed `l2-review#2` beside one signed `review#1`); the owed-review list (a mixed roster, taker text names both); the hand-off target (`l2-review#2`, `review#1`, three unreadable near-misses); the claim side (an `l2-review#1` signature is the review side); the knock (`l2-review#1` and `review#1` both pass).

<details>
<summary>Ablations, run on the first head b49563c6 (one behaviour each, through scripts/ablation-replace.mjs; mutation proven on disk, restore proven by blob hash and an empty git diff HEAD)</summary>

| `l2-review` from `SEAT_BARE_LANES` | mailbox-open self-test exit 1 (the new case throws on a null seat key) |
| the L2 word from the seat-title token | fleet-roster self-test exit 1, the new "a NEW L2 seat reads under its own word" case red |
| the L2 word from the hand-off target | record-recognisers self-test exit 1, 1 of 402 red (the new hand-off case) |
| the both-words predicate on the claim side | record-recognisers self-test exit 1, 1 of 402 red (the new claim case) |
| the both-words predicate in the owed-review roster | check-owed-reviews self-test exit 1, 1 of 90 red (the new mixed-roster case) |

The first attempt at the seat-title ablation was a no-op: the tool refused it because the replacement text was already a substring of the anchor, so its count did not rise. It was re-run with a distinct replacement; the row above is the second run.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

Against the card's six items:

1. Glossary: `SKILL.md` 〈审核两级〉, 5 bullets, covers all four required statements.
2. Census: below. Surfaces as the card lists them.
3. Renames, stubs, aliases: above. New writes use the new names; every old spelling still reads, and a self-test case pins each reader on both.
4. Naming: `L1-a` for new L1 threads (`area-lease.md`), `l2-review#N` for the L2 seat; running threads and seated seats keep their names.
5. Ceilings: two raises, both citing ruling record 6897685514 with the measured delta; everything else is within its row.
6. Gates: under Verification.

**Two open PRs touch the same lines** (this branch is based on neither):

When it lands first, its sentences win on substance and take this PR's words: 复核线程 and 本席 PR 复审线程 become L1 线程, 复核车道 becomes L2 席, `lanes/review.md` becomes `lanes/l2-review.md`, and its new independence sentence replaces line 20 of `lanes/l2-review.md` as written (it has no old word in it). Line 13 keeps this PR's naming clause (新开名 `L1-a`、`L1-b`…,在跑留原名).
- PR 33961 raises the `SKILL.md` ceiling by 1 for a lane row; with both landed the row is 329.

**Noted, not changed here**

- `check-owed-reviews.mjs` bars an L2 seat that sits on the PR's own account. PR 33938 removes that account rule from the charter; once it lands the tool and the text disagree. Carrier: the card behind PR 33938.
- `.claude/skills/checklist-test/SKILL.md` and `.claude/skills/spec-property-retirement/SKILL.md` use 复核 for a review step; they are outside the card's census surface.
- Retiring the old spellings (`review#N`, the two stub files) is follow-up work, proposed in the report with a measurable restart condition.
